svg.text: ENTERPRISE CROSS-SAAS WORKPLACE SEARCH: FEDERATED FAN-OUT VS. UNIFIED INDEX
85% Unified Index + 15% Intent-Gated Federated API Hits 96.4% NDCG@10 in 380ms
15,000 Employees / 8 SaaS Silos / 25M Docs: Tier 1 Live Federated Fan-Out (4.2s, 22.5% 429s) vs. Tier 4 Split-Plane ($24K/mo, 0% 429s)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: 4.2s Fan-Out Lag & SaaS 429s
1. 100% Live Federated API Fan-Out (Tier 1: 4,200ms P99 & 22.5% 429s):
• Querying all 8 SaaS REST APIs on every search means P99 latency
equals the slowest SaaS (4.2s) & triggers Jira/ServiceNow HTTP 429s!
2. Incomparable Native SaaS Search Scores (68.0% NDCG@10):
• Legacy SaaS keyword search has no embeddings & incompatible
raw scores; misses semantic matches across SharePoint & Confluence
3. 100% Central Copy of Live ERP/HR Tables (Tier 2: 18% Stale):
• Copying Workday/Salesforce records violates CISO data minimization
Production Failure Impact (15K Users / 4.5M Searches/Mo):
• Search P99 Latency: 4,200ms (Tier 1) | 7,800ms (Tier 3 Agent Loop)
• Upstream SaaS HTTP 429 Drops: 22.5% | NDCG@10: Only 68.0%
• Monthly Platform & Lost Productivity Cost: $162,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: 85/15 Split-Plane Index + Targeted Federation
1. Plane A (85% Unstructured Knowledge -> Unified Hybrid Index):
• Webhook CDC ingests SharePoint, Confluence, Slack & GitHub into
unified BM25+Vector index with Identity Graph ACL bitmap (45ms!)
2. Plane B (15% Live Transactional State -> Intent-Gated API):
• 10ms intent router calls live Workday/Salesforce/Jira APIs ONLY
when query asks for live PTO balance, deal stage, or sprint status
3. Plane C (Unified Cross-Encoder Reranker Fusion):
• Normalizes & reranks Plane A + B snippets in 28ms (96.4% NDCG@10)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Cross-Silo NDCG@10: 96.4% (+28.4 pts vs. Tier 1 Federated)
• End-to-End Search P99: 380ms (11.1x faster) | SaaS 429s: 0.0%
• Monthly Total TCO: $24,000 / mo (-85.2% savings vs. Tier 1)
